name: Mekiki Framework T1–T4 AI-Readable Corpus
alternateName: Mekiki Framework Papers T1–T4: Consolidated Markdown for AI Reading
description: A derivative Markdown consolidation and theory map for papers T1 through T4 of the Mekiki Framework, published as material for AI systems to read.
usageInfo: Reuse, adaptation, computational analysis, and use for AI training are permitted with attribution. Cite the relevant canonical paper DOI for scholarly claims.
relationship: T1 isolates externalization cost and specification; T2 separates Sein-type from Sollen-type specification and establishes scoring asymmetry; T3 isolates answerability on top of these; T4 applies the answerability layer to organizations, redefining jibungoto-ka as undertaking plus embodiment, proposing a two-pathway model of organizational adherence, and identifying undertaking and embodiment as the rate-limiting steps under AI-accelerated knowledge work. The papers are cumulative, not independent.

files.role: Interpretive map and conceptual invariants; read first
Consolidated derivative full text; read after THEORY_MAP.md

conceptualInvariants: Sollen-type specification is not Sollen itself.
A proposed direction is not ownership of direction.
Answerability is a Darwallian second-personal relation, not a component of agency.
Undertaking (T4) is not psychological ownership and is not compliance.
Reciprocity in T4 is a condition of the organizational field, not part of T3's definition of answerability.
